title: Using photographs in campaigns

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Allow campaign invention while retaining recognition because a surprising idea still needs to be attributed to its source.
strategic_value: Helsinki can vary photographic concepts without losing the city identity that connects them.
demonstration: This expanded webpage section introduces broad campaign freedom and shows four credited campaign applications.
practical_value: Evaluate whether an inventive campaign remains recognizable as Helsinki.

content_islands.name: Campaign scope
content_islands.spec: Place the freedom-and-recognition statement above the examples.

content_islands.name: Campaign examples
content_islands.spec: Show the credited photographic campaign compositions in paired groups.

reference_purposes.Application: The examples demonstrate photographic concepts in city campaigns.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Campaigns must remain recognizable as part of Helsinki’s brand and visual identity.
